entities.summary: Kim Sung-hwan is a South Korean politician who was South Korea's Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade from 8 October 2010 to 24 February 2013. His previous positions include Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade and Senior Secretary to the President for Foreign Affairs and National Security.
